newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close mixed, liquidity stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close mixed, liquidity stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed mixed on Thursday with market liquidity remaining stable even after the central bank halted its recent moves to mop up excess funds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 6.814 percent against Wednesday's 6.767 close, still well outside the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone, but 30-day commercial paper fell to 6.75 percent from 7.00.

Before Thursday the central bank repeatedly had issued negotiable certificates of deposit in an apparent bid to tighten liquidity with the aim of slightly cooling down a steadily rallying stock market, dealers said. The stock index inched to a slightly higher close on Thursday, gaining 13.08 points to a six-year high of 8,268.15.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1425 percent against 6.1550 and the seven-year 85/3 bond yield stayed unchanged at 5.8500.
